cases.label: The March 2020 crash
cases.about: The Covid sell-off. India went into lockdown on 25 March 2020; the market bottomed the day before.
cases.summary: The median stock fell -54.2% from 2020-01-16 to 2020-03-24, and took 96 sessions to get back.

cases.label: 4 June 2024 - election result day
cases.about: The day the general election result came in with a smaller majority than the exit polls had suggested. Index futures had priced a landslide.
cases.summary: On 2024-06-04 the average stock moved -5.9% and 1820 of 1925 fell.

cases.label: January 2023 - the Adani report
cases.about: A short-seller report on the Adani group. The group's own stocks fell far more than the market; this is the average of every listed stock.
cases.summary: On 2023-01-27 the average stock moved -2.1% and 1586 of 1854 fell.

note: What actually happened, measured on the median listed stock rather than the Nifty, because a beginner's portfolio is not 50 large caps.

cautions.median: Equal-weight median of every listed stock that day, not an index.
cautions.survivorship: Only stocks listed today are included. Real falls were slightly worse than shown.
cautions.not_advice: Past crashes do not predict the next one's size or timing.
